EmailTemplate.subject: Craft a More Resilient Revenue Cycle
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Believe it or not, online payments have nearly doubled since the start of Covid-19. While other collection channels have suffered significant setbacks, digital channels have soared.
Not only has digital been a powerful way for patients and doctors to stay connected during the pandemic, but health systems who have implemented strong digital channels have proven to be more resilient, better equipped, and faster to recover from the effects of Covid-19 than health systems who haven’t.
Learning how to add the right digital strategies into your collections process could be the difference between having a revenue cycle that bounces back quickly from Covid-19 and one that doesn’t.
If you’re looking for where to start, join AdventHealth and Banner Health this Thursday for a very special panel discussion <[[https://go.beckershospitalreview.com/how-adventhealth-banner-health-built-a-modern-financial-experience-that-innovated-at-every-stage-in-the-patient-journey?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> on how to build a modern financial experience based on efficiency and innovation.
